name: T’karas Prime
role: Neutral Velari world; site of the Debate at T’karas
description: A neutral Velari world — aligned to no Velar successor faction — which made it viable ground for a Union diplomatic approach to the Velar reformists. Its neutrality is the reason the Debate at T’karas took place there.
political_character: Neutral. Consistent with the Velar political spectrum’s "Neutral Houses" (org_neutral_houses): Velar groupings that hedge rather than commit to Loyalist, Reformist or Warlord camps.
notable_features: Held local planetary archives, disabled by an explosion during the Debate at T’karas.
